review:
Bizarre is a 5x4 Nolimit City slot with a carnival-of-monsters theme. xSplit symbols land on reels 1 and 5, as single symbols or full four-row stacks, and split the symbols in their path to increase the number of ways.

Three scatters start three Chimera Spins, where a scatter on the middle reel turns into a sticky wild. Super Chimera Spins add a super scatter for even more. A paid Coinage mode fills the reels with multiplier coins and special symbols. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 20,000x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
